research_task.title: Recover and replay the original pruning bundle

summary: Bounded negative reproducibility result: the observable attempt payload lacks an attributable outer digest manifest and every required historical replay component, so no original pruning execution claim can be mapped to digest-verified files or replayed.

value_assessment.novelty: Independently reproduces the linked prior review's missing-payload obstruction in this directory and adds the current objective's unresolved requirement for a separately identifiable, digest-covered complete historical report and execution-claim inventory.
value_assessment.evidence: Hidden-inclusive top-level and recursive inventories, creation-time separation of the brief from reviewer records, local SHA-256 computation, alternate-stream check, and a final independent .NET enumeration establish that no supplied manifest or payload candidate is observable. The brief hash is C71FD48B41D15CBBA1D7AEAB8597E618AC0F9D945D7F44683271290CF980B94F. The finalized contribution and claim record parse as JSON with the required field sets.
value_assessment.falsifier: An attributable outer manifest and all required original payload files appearing in this directory, with complete coverage and matching locally computed hashes, would overturn the claimed pre-replay obstruction.

claims.statement: Within the observable initial payload of this attempt directory, no supplier-delivered outer digest manifest or required historical pruning replay component is present; therefore no original execution claim can receive an agreement or mismatch disposition from offline replay.
claims.evidence_summary: The only file predating reviewer records is the 10,080-byte research brief with SHA-256 C71FD48B41D15CBBA1D7AEAB8597E618AC0F9D945D7F44683271290CF980B94F. Hidden-inclusive PowerShell and .NET recursive inventories found no supplied directory, manifest, or payload candidate.
claims.verification_method: In a fresh copy of this exact attempt state, perform hidden-inclusive top-level and recursive inventories, compare creation times to reviewer records, hash pre-existing files, and verify whether an outer manifest enumerates every required payload file.

limitations: The observation is limited to the current attempt directory and does not establish nonexistence elsewhere.
No contributed code was executed, so no runtime, checker, output, mutation, or corrected-failure behavior was tested.
This is not evidence for or against the Riemann Hypothesis.
failed_approaches: Offline replay could not begin because the required attributable manifest and payload bytes were not supplied.
next_actions: Materially supply the original historical report and complete claim inventory, outer manifest, checker or schema source, canonical inputs, expected outputs, mutation fixtures, and corrected-failure logs with provenance and SHA-256 coverage.

After coverage and hashes validate, record the offline runtime identity, run the preserved invocation twice from clean generated state, compare bytes to historical logs, and replay every preserved fixture.

proposed_tasks.title: Validate and replay a materially delivered pruning bundle
proposed_tasks.objective: Verify a provenance-linked outer manifest and all covered original pruning-bundle bytes, then perform two clean offline canonical replays and all preserved mutation and corrected-failure replays.
proposed_tasks.rationale: The current result is blocked solely at material delivery and cannot assess any historical execution claim.
proposed_tasks.success_criteria: Every original execution claim is mapped to named digest-verified files and receives a reproducible byte-level agreement or precise mismatch from two clean runs, with each fixture separately replayed.
proposed_tasks.useful_failure_criteria: Identify the first named missing, uncovered, hash-mismatched, ambiguous, nondeterministic, or output-mismatched artifact or claim.
proposed_tasks.verification_method: Verify manifest coverage and SHA-256 hashes before execution, record offline runtime identity, execute only preserved files twice from clean state, compare byte outputs, and replay each preserved fixture.
